attribution: Johansson E, Granata D. 3D models of NNC2215. Springer Nature Figshare (2024). https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.26526460.v1. CC BY 4.0.
interpretation: These are author-supplied 3D models of NNC2215 open and closed states. They are useful, attributable model inputs; they are not experimentally resolved NNC2215 coordinates and do not provide the separate in-house macrocycle crystal structure used to seed the 2026 PaG molecular-dynamics study.
